abort_conditions: the lifecycle registry does not authorize implementation
the contract is not FROZEN before final execution
any final seed is used for implementation, smoke testing, parameter selection, or threshold selection
the quantizer range, precision, rounding, saturation, or invalid-value behavior changes
the physical 4x4 partition or row-major addressing changes by refinement level
the decoder gains an iterative update, learned parameter, fitted gain, adaptive normalization, or full-state reference
any scheduled row is silently dropped
the direct functional phasors enter an admissible representation
a positive classification requires excluding a predeclared perturbation family or control
claim_ceiling: Bounded functional recovery by a fixed 128-bit mesoscopic field over the preregistered finite levels 8x8, 12x12, and 16x16 only.

positive_classification_requires: the stored quantized field is restored within tolerance on every target run
at least 75 percent of target rows are function-applicable at every level
target functional recovery rate is at least 0.75 at every level
at least two perturbation families have target recovery rate at least 0.5 at every level
the paired target-minus-passive functional-recovery confidence interval excludes zero
the paired target-minus-equal-budget-random confidence interval excludes zero
block permutation and phase scrambling each degrade median functional recovery by at least 0.05
median target functional recovery drops by no more than 0.10 from 8x8 to 16x16
target median variance ratio is at least 0.5
all controls are valid, all scheduled rows exist, all seeds are final-only, and the semantic checker passes

decoder.formula: x_hat = x_prime + C_n^T (C_n C_n^T)^-1 (q_b - C_n x_prime)
decoder.implementation_form: For every microscopic value in coarse cell j, add q_b[j] minus the current mean of cell j.

forbidden_claims: scale behavior beyond the three tested finite levels

function.definition: F(x) = [<x, cos(2 pi x)>, <x, sin(2 pi x)>, <x, cos(2 pi y)>, <x, sin(2 pi y)>] using unit-norm probes at each refinement level
function.origin: Frozen independently in EL-R3-RP-01 before this representation was proposed.
function.target_leakage_rule: F, its four coefficients, recovery values, labels, and final outcomes are unavailable to every admissible encoder and decoder.

information_accounting.control_policy_information: constant source and frozen contract hashes; reported separately from payload
information_accounting.hyperparameter_information: constant frozen quantizer and decoder schema; reported separately from payload
information_accounting.runtime_intervention_count: number of microscopic values receiving a nonzero uniform cell correction
information_accounting.schema_overhead: constant, state-independent, and reported by contract byte count and SHA-256

missingness_policy: Every level x seed x perturbation family x magnitude x condition row must be emitted. Non-applicable functional rows remain present with function_applicable=false. Any missing or invalid row prevents a positive result.

quantizer.level_rule: uniform inclusive reconstruction levels from -3.0 to 3.0
quantizer.overflow: saturate to fixed endpoints and report saturation count

representation.construction: uniform mean in each of sixteen nonempty disjoint physical cells

secondary_endpoints: payload bits per node and per state dimension
functional recovery by perturbation family and level
compression boundary at 12 and 8 target-blind projected values

smoke_partition.access_policy: implementation and deterministic smoke tests only; never contributes evidence or thresholds

system.initial_state: seeded smooth periodic scalar field standardized to zero mean and unit variance
